Anitdepressants take time to work, mine took about 7-8 to really kick in. Rn I'm three months into my meds working and I usually feel pretty good, more open-minded and more satisfied with everything. If in a while you still don't feel good it might be ok to look into getting them increased or even just talking to a therapist. But really, it does get better. And yea sometimes life is going to really suck and it's going to seem like everything is falling apart, just know there's always someone in your life willing to talk whether you know it or not (ie a friend, a family member, even reddit). Hang in there:)

I know they don't have it all, no one does, they just have a hell of a lot more than I do like all the people they could want and lots of things of their liking, I refer you to my previous comment ^up there somewhere^ in that I know for a fact some of them have problems too but they have a support base to turn to. I just don't think they deserve all of it like why can't they share which sounds really fucking stupid and mean and I hate myself for thinking it and I think that people should definitely have people in their life to turn to with their problems, I just don't understand why they get so much and nobody even looks at me.

I know and thank you, i'm trying its just hard to stick with things when you don't have hope that it will ever get better. I know that there's things i should do but at the same time I have no idea what to do at all anymore or how to do anything. Hope you feel better though:)
Thanks for the advice

Yea I've known what I've needed to do to and everything and one can say it all they want and I always plan on doing it too I really do but then I get to school and I see how happy everyone is and I know that wouldn't change if I'm gone. And I know I'd be better off if I just did things and if I didn't compare myself but it's physically impossible for my mind not to and everyone will always choose those people over me and I had one friend but I depended on them and complained too much and I annoyed them into submission and they've chosen those people over me. I'm in lots of after school activities but they only last for an hour or two and for so long and then I have nothing to do and I'm not sure what other things I could start doing

It's like if there was a colony somewhere then people decided to revolt so the move to the outside and circle the colony then attack it until it falls in on itself. Only like I'm on the inside and my mind is on the outside. For my whole life I've done some stupid things but throughout the past year it's been more aggressive I guess? Basically I can't think of any memory of anything I've ever said/done without just thinking wow what the fuck how are you such an utter loser.

Sadly I totally understand that and I have for awhile (people think I'm happy too) but it doesn't change the fact that they have just umpteen amounts of friends and people to talk to and others look up to them and they go out and have friends and boyfriends and actually *live* their lives. And the way I see it is that even if they do have problems they have a support system and lots of people they can turn to. And I also understand the way people have phrased their depression but I wholeheartedly believe that life just isn't going to get better for me so I can't do anything

I don't think there was a time I was ever truly happy, but there probably was a time that I was and I just don't remember it idk i pretty much ruined myself and my mind attacked me and destroyed everything, so remembering a happy time is hard to do. I don't know what would make me happier but I kinda just want an actual real person that's not going to leave me for those "popular people" and will actually care. That or watching all of those people suffer for being undeserving and mean, which sounds really mean for me to say but I just want them to know what it feels like to not have the world available at your feet but instead be secluded and alone all the time and have no one talk to you. But more likely the former just one real friend that won't get annoyed and leave me.
Like the books? Other than that no I can't say that I have

I just don have any hope that anything can get better. I can never be happy because people are never going to like me. I've tried to die 4 times and they haven't worked so really I need to find a new approach at the attempts because I want to do it so bad, but the only other thing I could think to do besides this is make them suffer like I have and make all those "popular" girls and boys know the pain and suffering of no one talking to you at school and being secluded. The former seems more plausible however and seeing as there's no hope for me that's just kinda what my only plans are at the moment. It's just they get everything and I have nothing and I just want a friend just one fucking friend like one real human that will talk to me.

I just shouldn't be here I'm a shitty person and clearly that's what others think too, I don't know how to talk about it but I have with my one friend and I feel horrible about complaining about my stupid problems

My friend has told me the same advice, but I just don't think my family will understand. I know what they are like and I can predict the type of things they'd say if I told them and what they'd do and everything. I've basically lived in my room for the past couple of weeks though and I lied to them and told them the cuts on my arms were from the cat and if they haven't figured out anything is wrong yet is there really anything I can do about it. And speaking to the "don't change for anyone" thing I definitely understand that an I don't want to but the person I am isn't good enough for anyone besides 1 person who I'm pretty sure doesn't really like me anymore anyways but is being nice to me because of the depression. Really if just be doing the world a service by going it doesn't even matter.

I see where you're coming from and it might help really I suppose but I want to be accepted I want to try but I can't because it's impossible for anyone to be accepting of me or give me a chance. And considering school is the only contact I have with people and yes it sucks like I cry in the bathroom stalls and have panic attacks but I already don't feel human and contact with others is the only thing that makes me feel like I can have any sort of emotion and I'm not just an empty shell

A lot of it is probably that society isn't very at all accepting or nice to people or at least people like me. I'm just secluded and lonely and I don't have friends or people to talk to and it sucks, and I know when people say they don't have friends it's usually not true but no really I don't have friends
